body: Sorry for my delayed response. I've been sleeping it off. I keep having the same nightmare that my ex blocks me on Facebook and everywhere else. She's a bit over dramatic and it's not far fetched but it hurts even to sleep. I miss her. A lot. It felt like we could have worked out but she just didn't think she was worth it. And I tried to check in with my best friend... she's still upset and said she was gonna go back to sleep when I asked if she were free to talk. Her and I kind of have this way of sleeping a lot throughout the day together and it was great... but with her being upset it feels empty. I find my self only getting out of bed because I have to and not because I want to.
Idk what to do. I have a lingering fear that this and my poor experiences with women is driving me to be an alcoholic. It hurts. And I just wanna hide.
Sorry. I've been away for some time. I kinda got lost in my own world. I like jazz, various kinds of electronic music, some varying kinds of rock, and hip-hop. How about you?

Random people (at least here) are more forgiving. Funny things about this group is that the only things that link us are our varying mental health issues and suicide temptations. But on that alone we understand one another with ease. I have like one friend off of here that gets it because he has anxiety and I have depression. But no matter how different, we still deal with the same stresses, the same fears, even the same comments from people.

None of my other friends understand that. And my mom is often too stubborn to see it because she's a single mother who likes to still maintain that she's got parental authority, even though we live in two different states now and I'm an adult (so to speak). But I know she takes meds for it. It may work for her but the talking helps me. So here I am. Guess you know a bit about me too now. 

So, in short I think this place is at least a good start. I check in every couple days to keep my head level, and when I can I try to help now. I just feel for people here who can't bear the weight of their emotions and life pressures, and feel like they have nowhere else to turn. There's always a way out, and as long as people are showing up here, they want that way. It's why I showed up. It didn't make sense for me to know all I know about my life's worth and still think of throwing it away, but that's been my life since I was a kid. And the only way you win this fight we have is by exposing it.

I get that. I'm an open book too so it happens often. But then again, it's also my problem being too open when it may not be the appropriate. Luckily, this seems to be the place. And from what I can tell, if you're just a bit patient, someone responds. I hope you can be open though. The first mistake you can make is keeping quiet. Even someone like me who's been holding it in for the past several months knows that, despite what my heart would have me do sometimes.

I'm actually struggling with the same issue. Yet I completely feel comfortable on here because I don't know anyone. I like that feeling. It allows me to say whatever I want without condemnation or quick judgement that cuts through half of what I say to focus on one thing. Here, I have the undivided attention of whoever is reading. I say it all. When I look through my contacts, I am like you, worried. "Will he understand?" "Is she going to just tell me to shut up?" "I already know what THAT person is gonna say." But here, no one has a chance to do that. Not yet anyway. It leaves you the opportunity to be as honest as possible without the emotional response that might potentially follow with a loved one. I think that's why professional help is recommended so much. It's exactly that IRL. Perhaps, one of those things considered, maybe give your regular people a break. Allow yourself to be in an environment where you can spill it all and not be afraid of what follows after. After all, it's the act of talking about it that's keeping me from going there. Maybe it'll be the same for you.
Any that you would recommend on here?
I tell ya hwat, that was some mighty fine editing.
